title.value: Learning tabu search algorithms: A scheduling application
title.justification: The paper focuses on developing a learning algorithm to improve tabu search in scheduling applications.
title.quote: The main objective of this paper is to demonstrate that metaheuristics, particularly tabu search, can behave more intelligently and efficiently by gathering and using the data generated during the search process.

extractions.description: This paper introduces a learning algorithm aimed at improving the performance of tabu search algorithms by reducing their search space and evaluation effort. The method leverages classification approaches like logistic regression and decision trees to guide the tabu search process more efficiently. The paper evaluates the algorithm through a physician scheduling application, demonstrating improved performance under both deterministic and stochastic conditions. It emphasizes the benefit of integrating machine learning techniques into metaheuristics to enhance combinatorial optimization problems.
